definition: to cook with dry heat in an oven
description: Two hands rinse a raw rack of lamb ribs in a fast mountain stream, with green hills and grazing horses behind. The rack is then laid on a flat stone slab set over glowing red coals and slowly browns, steaming, with the sun low over the hills. A man inflates a big white tent on the grass with an orange pump. Inside the tent, on a patterned carpet, two men sit at a low wooden table and eat the roasted ribs, which are served on a bed of lettuce with cherry tomatoes.
